senses.gloss: स-वेणु-वीणा-पणव-अनुनाद + म् स-वेणु-वीणा-पणव-अनुनाद + म्, adv. re-echoing with flutes, lutes, and tabors.
स-अवज्ञ स-अवज्ञ, adj. disdainful;
सावज्ञम् सावज्ञम्, adv. with contempt, Rām. 3, 29, 2.
स- + अवधान स- + अवधान, adj. careful, attentive, Yājñ. 3, 112.
स- + अवधि स- + अवधि, adj. with the end, Kathās. 9, 52.
स- + अवलम्ब स- + अवलम्ब, adj. supported, Ragh. 19, 50.
स- + अवलेप स- + अवलेप, adj. Proud, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 19.

स- + अवशेष स- + अवशेष, adj. 1. leaving a residue. 2. imperfect. 3. remaining, सावशेष-बन्धन, adj. still bound, Pañc. 109, 17. 4. till, मृद्-भाण्ड-, adj. exclusive of the earthen pots, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 14.
स- + अवष्टम्भ स- + अवष्टम्भ, adj. full of self-confidence, Pañc. i. d. 215;
स- + अवहेल स- + अवहेल, adj. despising.
सव्य- + इतर सव्य- + इतर, adj. right, Ragh. 12, 90.
सावित्री- + पतित सावित्री- + पतित, m. a man of the three first classes, not invested at the proper time with the sacrificial cord, Man. 2, 39.
स-अवशेष- + बन्धन स-अवशेष- + बन्धन, adj. still bound, Pañc. 109, 17.

स- + वयस् स- + वयस्,
 I. adj. contemporary.
 II. m. a contemporary, a friend.
 III. f. a woman's female friend, Śiś. 9, 53.

स- + वर्ण स- + वर्ण,
 I. adj. 1. like, resembling, Megh. 18. 2. of the same caste, kind, MBh. 2, 865.
 II. f. णा, Chāyā, the wife of the sun.
स-वाष्प + म् स-वाष्प + म्, adv. with tears in his eyes, Pañc. 243, 4.
स- + वास स- + वास, adj. 1. having a dwelling. 2. scented.
स- + वासस् स- + वासस्, adj. clothed.
स- + विकल्प स- + विकल्प, adj. admitting of an alternative, distinguishing, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 1.
स- + विकाश स- + विकाश, adj. expanded, extensive.
स- + विग्रह स- + विग्रह, adj. 1. embodied, living, Rājat. 5, 27. 2. meaning, importing.
स-वितर्क + म् स-वितर्क + म्, adv. thoughtfully, Śāk. 33, 11.
स- + विद्य स- + विद्य, adj. 1. learned, Rājat. 5, 178. 2. wise.
स- + विध स- + विध, adj. 1. of the same kind. 2. near, Mālat. 7, 14.
स- + विनय स- + विनय, adj. well-behaved, modest, Ṛt. 6, 21. ˚यम्-, adv. humbly, modestly, Pañc. 47, 1; Vikr. 86, 10; graciously, Hit. 12, 2, M.M.
स- + विभ्रम स- + विभ्रम, adj. playing, looking amorously, Ṛt. 1, 12; 6, 23.
स-विमर्श + म् स-विमर्श + म्, adv. thoughtfully, Śāk. 58, 4.
स- + विलास स- + विलास, adj. amorous, wanton, Śiś. 9, 26; ˚सम्, adv. by expressive looks, Mālat. 15, 6.
स- + विशेष स- + विशेष, adj. 1. having discrimination, Hit. 55, 13. 2. having characteristic qualities. 3. extraordinary, Hit. 60, 6, M.M.
स- + विशेषक स- + विशेषक, adj. discriminated, having distinguishing properties, Bhāṣāp. 1.
स- + विशेषण स- + विशेषण, adj. distinguished, characterised.
स- + विशेषतस् स- + विशेषतस्, adv. particularly, excellently.
स-विषाद + म् स-विषाद + म्, adv. afflicted, Pañc. 107, 19; sorrowful, Vikr. 30, 12.
स- + विस्तर स- + विस्तर, adj. with (its) detail, complete, Pañc. 114, 20.
स-विस्मय स-विस्मय, adj., f. या, 1. surprised, Pañc. 44, 24. 2. doubtful, Hit. 54, 18. 3. ˚यम्, adv. surprised, Pañc. 76, 24.
स-वेग + म् स-वेग + म्, adv. hastily, Pañc. 89, 13.
स- + वेश स- + वेश, adj. 1. near. 2. dressed, ornamented.
स-वैक्लव्य + म् स-वैक्लव्य + म्, adv. despairingly, 164, 7.
स-वैराग्य + म् स-वैराग्य + म्, adv. sorrowfully, Pañc. 66, 20.
स- + वैलक्ष्य स- + वैलक्ष्य, adj. abashed, embarrassed, Rājat. 5, 60. ˚यम्, adv. embarrassed, Vikr. 32, 10.
स- + व्यथ स- + व्यथ, Adj. 1. suffering pain, with distress, Hit. 113, 13. 2. sorrowful, Śiś. 9, 83.
स- + व्यपेक्षा स- + व्यपेक्षा, adj. connected, Utt. Rāmac. 146, 7.
स- + व्यभिचार स- + व्यभिचार, m. a too general middle term (as fire to prove smoke).
स-व्याज स-व्याज, adj. 1. cunning, pretending. 2. fraudulent. ˚जम्, adv. cunningly, under a pretext, Śāk. 18, 21; Vikr. 12, 18.
स- + व्रीड स- + व्रीड, adj., f. डा, 1. ashamed, Chr. 61, 42. 2. bashful, Chr. 5, 4; Vikr. 10, 12. 3. modest. ˚डम्, adv. 1. with shame, ashamed, Pañc. 208, 13. 2. bashfully, Vikr. 28, 14.

शव् शव्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To go.
 2. To alter, to change, to destroy.

शव शव,
 I. m. and n. A dead body, Man. 4, 108; Pañc. v. d. 24 (m.); Kathās. 4, 107 (m.).
 II. n. Water.

शाव शाव,
 I. i. e. शव + अ, adj.
 1. Relating to, or produced by, a dead body, Man. 5, 59.
 2. Dead, Sāv. 5, 61.
 II. (akin to श्वि, cf. शिशु), m. The young of any animal, Utt. Rāmac. 122, 12 (सिंह-, A lion's cub).

सव सव, i. e. सु, and सू, + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Sacrifice.
 2. Offspring.
 3. The sun.
 4. The moon.
 II. n.
 1. Sprinkling [] the Soma, or juice of the acid Asclepias.
 2. The juice of flowers.
 3. Water.
 --Comp.

शवर शवर, m.
 1. A barbarian tribe, a Śavara, Nalod. 3, 37.
 2. f. री, A female of that tribe, Utt. Rāmac. 19, 14.
 3. Śiva.
 4. Water.
 --Comp.

शावर शावर, i. e. शवर + अ,
 I. adj. Low, vile.
 II. m.
 1. Fault.
 2. Sin, wickedness.

शवल शवल,
 I. adj.
 1. Variegated, of a variegated colour, Mālat. 145, 12; grown or yellow, Vikr. d. 109 (cf. Wilson, Spec. of the Theatre of the Hind. 2. ed. i. 250, n.).
 2. Imitative.
 3. Articulated, Rājat. 5, 68 (divided, viz. by rivers).
 II. f. ली.
 1. A brindled cow. []
 2. The cow of plenty, Vaśiṣṭha's cow, Rām. 1, 52, 21.
 III. n. Water.
शवलत्व शवल + त्व, n. Alternation, Mālat. 161, 5.

शवस् शवस्, i. e. शु (= श्वि) + अस्, n.
 1. Power, strength, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.
 2. A corpse.
 --Comp.
शावक शाव + क, m. The young of any animal Hit. 39, 4, M.M.

सवन सवन, i. e. सु, and सू, + अन,
 I. m. The moon.
 II. n.
 1. Extracting and drinking the Soma, or juice of the acid Asclepias.
 2. A sacrifice, Rām. 1, 13, 5.
 3. Bearing children, bringing forth young.

सावन सावन, i. e. सु, Caus., + अन, m.
 1. An employer of priests for a sacrifice.
 2. The ceremonies by which a sacrifice is terminated.
 3. Varuṇa.
 4. A month of thirty solar days.

सवितृ सवितृ, i. e. सू + तृ,
 I. m. The sun, Vikr. d. 20.
 II. f. त्री, A mother.
 III. adj. Causing, Kir. 3, 5.
सवृद्धिक स-वृद्धि + क, adj. Bearing interest.

सव्य सव्य, adj.
 1. Left, left hand, Pañc. i. d. 86.
 2. Southern, south.
 3. Backward, reverse, contrary.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. σκαιός; Lat. scævus, probably also sinister.
सव्यतस् सव्य + तस्, adv. On one's left hand, Chr. 31, 14.
सव्यसाचिन् सव्यसाचिन्, perhaps सव्य-स-अञ्च् + इन् (cf. साचि), m. (Drawing the bow with his left hand), a name of Arjuna, Pañc. iii. d. 237.
सव्येष्ठृ सव्येष्ठृ, i. e. सव्य + इ-स्थार् (स्थार् for स्थान्, with र् for न्, and स्थान् for स्थान्त्, old ptcple. pres. of स्था), m. A charioteer.
सावधानता सावधानता, i. e. स-अवधान + ता, f. Carefulness, Pañc. 34, 23.

सावर्णि सावर्णि, i. e. स-वर्ण + इ, m. The eighth Manu, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 11.
 --Comp.
सावर्ण्य सावर्ण्य, i. e. स-वर्न + य, n. Identity of caste.

सावित्र सावित्र, i. e. सवितृ + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Descended from the sun, Utt. Rāmac. 132, 3.
 2. Belonging to the dynasty descended from the sun, ib. 27, 13.
 II. m.
 1. The sun.
 2. Śiva.
 3. A Vasu or demigod so called.
 4. Karṇa, child of the sun.
 5. One of the Nakṣatras, or lunar asterisms, Johns. Sel. 15, 62.
 III. f. त्री.
 1. A beam of light, a cluster of solar rays.
 2. Umā, the wife of Śiva, Sāv. 1, 7.
 3. A proper name, Sāv. 1, 21.
 4. The name of the most holy verse of the Rigv. (iii. 62, 11), Man. 2, 77; 11, 191.
 5. The ceremony of investiture with the sacrificial string, Man. 2, 38.
 IV. n. The sacrificial string.
सावित्री- + सूत्र सावित्री- + सूत्र, n. the sacrificial cord.
स-विद्युत्- + स्तनित स-विद्युत्- + स्तनित, adj. with lightning and thunder.
स-वाष्प-स्तम्भ + म् स-वाष्प-स्तम्भ + म्, adv. suppressing tears, Utt. Rāmac. 45, 5.
